verdicts.reason: Both have the same broken structure. The 'SUNSET SALE' eyebrow drops below the body copy, so the reading order is wrong. The logo gets shoved into the bottom-left corner on top of a squashed ellipse that bleeds off the canvas. The fine print is nearly as large as the subhead. The 30% OFF/copy/eyebrow/CTA stack is jammed together under an empty top band, and the circles are distorted into ovals. B is slightly worse: its box and CTA run almost edge to edge with very thin side margins, and its logo sits even tighter in the corner. A keeps a little more breathing room.
